items.title: Frank Goudie Interview
items.q: But in the wintertime during Truby Cain's season, you don't wait for the sun to rise. You've got to be there when you can see that stick going and going of Cain...

ctx.x: Oh. Northern New York. Northern New York. Well, it's south west. Oh, way over at the... Yeah. Spider-Golf in Mexico. That came to Kent, that has a lot of meaning in the Nicholas music, doesn't it? Yes, because it means from sunrise to sundown. And boy, there's no blues more miserable than knowing that you're going to have to wake up to face that. Again. There's your blues.

And the head man, he's home. He have his boy that's going to ring the bell when the sun... Yeah. And he better be up and ring the bell so the whole vacation... And you can experience a bit of joy when it's over. At the evening. And he can get up and see, you ring that bell and you ring it hard so every... all the farmers know he has to get up and the sun is rising by the time you can see. Yeah.
